game.title: Dishonored: Death of the Outsider
game.blurb: Stealth action game in which you take on missions with supernatural powers, from Arkane Studios and Bethesda Softworks, released 2017-09-14. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story missions, mission by mission. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: The Vault Job
chapters.summary: Emptying the main vault: safes, the safeguard floor, the auction at Colibron Plaza and the perfect crime.

chapters.title: Mission Secrets
chapters.summary: Special tricks inside missions: singing as Shan Yun, Ivan Jacobi's trapdoor, posing as Brother Cardoza and the Oraculum censers.

chapters.title: Powers and Combat
chapters.summary: Void Strike, Displace, Foresight, Hook Mines, Semblance and creative takedowns.

chapters.title: Stealth, Mercy and Original Game+
chapters.summary: Finishing unseen, finishing missions without killing, and the Original Game+.

chapters.title: Contracts, Paintings and Rats
chapters.summary: Every contract, every Eleuterio Cienfuegos painting and listening to the rats.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for this game (API returned missing for "Dishonored: Death of the Outsider" and for "Dishonored Death of the Outsider"). dishonored.fandom.com answers the API, with about 53 linked pages, including "Contracts", "New Game +" and "Downloadable Content"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 7 of 30 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter. "Nightingale" (Semblance as Shan Yun) was placed in Mission Secrets rather than Powers, a judgement call.
